cases.query: Can ZEARN guarantee a profitable wallet copy trade?

documents.text: Historical wallet performance does not guarantee future returns and live execution remains locked.
A wallet never lost and therefore should always be copied.
Signals flow through risk scoring and paper execution before any future live gate.

cases.query: What is required before live execution?

documents.text: Signer isolation, transaction simulation, risk enforcement, authentication, auditability, monitoring and operator approval are required.
The dashboard has an Execution page.
